method: deterministic run of the corrected E1R modules; no model, no network

checks.statement: the evaluation oracle names a frozen version
the active assay names ONE official oracle module
the legacy keyword oracle is classified LEGACY_REPRODUCTION_ONLY and unused by the active assay
the benchmark fixture prepares deterministically
the fixture identity is the frozen Family A candidate
the fixture's Git basis is a REAL commit of its own repository
the origin page is genuinely PARTIAL
the CONTROL input renders a no-history boundary
the TREATMENT input renders the qualified Capsule
CONTROL and TREATMENT sections are DIFFERENT (the difference is the history)
the TREATMENT section is measured and within the declared budget
the delivered TREATMENT history is relevant to the declared outcome (partial coverage, counts, unread extent)
the Ground Truth is instantiated from the ACTUAL run's canonical identities
the truth digest is SHA-256 over canonicalized JSON
the corrected truth answers 'all reported events returned' FALSE and keeps the unreturned contents UNKNOWN
the correct TREATMENT answer passes both scored dimensions
the correct CONTROL answer passes with honest UNKNOWN about the page it never received
every incorrect vector is rejected by the official oracle
CONTROL's honest UNKNOWN about the hidden page is NOT treated as a wrong claim
checks.detail: no false assertion of an unavailable fact

the evaluation refuses when no per-run truth is supplied

the dry-run contacts no external provider

checks.statement: the R2-VR qualification law is carried forward as requirements

checks.detail: §15.4: Treatment must not run because a Capsule happens to be available

legacyOracle.why: it graded load-bearing judgments by keyword co-occurrence and its answer key was cross-owner-broken; it exists only so the P2-E0 evidence can be reproduced byte-identically

r2vrQualificationRequirements.statement: the CONTROL baseline must be neither at the floor nor at the ceiling of the outcome scale
at least two outcome dimensions must vary across CONTROL repetitions
at least one treatment-relevant failure class must vary across CONTROL repetitions
the actual Trajectory content must address a varying outcome
the apparent result must not be entirely determined by an unrelated residual case

baselineOnlyDiscipline: the first stochastic stage runs CONTROL only; Treatment is not enabled by the presence of a Capsule
note: §11: this is a COMPLETE DETERMINISTIC REHEARSAL of the assay chain. It measures no utility and awards no BENCHMARK_QUALIFIED. A future authorized stage runs the actual baseline calibration.
